name: fako-journeys
description: Static site for a Cameroonian tour operator, plus the tourism image system that generates the country pages.
//: Deliberately dependency-free and with no build script: the deployed site is static HTML, and adding a build script here would make the host try to run one. These commands are thin wrappers over the Python engine in tools/tourism/, which needs nothing but python3.

scripts.lint: python3 -m py_compile tools/build_images.py tools/tourism/*.py tools/tourism/providers/*.py && echo 'lint: ok'
scripts.typecheck: python3 -m py_compile tools/build_images.py tools/tourism/*.py tools/tourism/providers/*.py && echo 'typecheck: ok (no TypeScript in this project)'
